# Synthetic speech fixtures

Generated by Windows System.Speech synthesis using the exact public test phrases in `scripts/validate_local_speech.py`. These files contain no microphone recordings or personal messages.

The small mono PCM16 WAV fixtures make English/Russian recognition regression checks repeatable on CI machines without requiring a Russian Windows voice installation. Generate again with:

```powershell
.venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/validate_local_speech.py --generate-fixtures
```

The phrases and expected command events are defined in the script. Normal sentences and a sentence continuing after "Stop GPT" must produce no command.
